shared_elements: seated/standing figures with offerings or held objects
low relief carving of figures in registers/rows
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in profile carved in low relief and organised in horizontal registers or files, with figures holding or presenting objects, which is a real but fairly generic correspondence. A shows small figures interspersed among dense columns of script-like signs in a compact panel, while B shows a continuous procession of tall standing figures along an architectural wall with no writing, and no processional file appears in A.
